item.title: Android Developer Verification
item.description:
📝 Today, we’re starting to roll out Android developer verification to all developers in both the new Android Developer Console and Play Console. This allows you to complete your verification and register your apps before user-facing changes begin later this year. The Android developer verification page in your Play Console will show the registration status for each of your apps.
🔗 Read more: https://android-developers.googleblog.com/2026/03/android-developer-verification-rolling-out-to-all-developers.html

item.title: Incident March 30th, 2026 – Accidental CDN Caching
item.description:
📝 For those affected, this may have resulted in potentially authenticated data being served to unauthenticated users. During this window, cached responses may have been served to users other than the original requester, which meant potentially unauthenticated data is served to authenticated users. Users with domains affected by this incident will be notified via e-mail shortly.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.railway.com/p/incident-report-march-30-2026-accidental-cdn-caching
